metrics.label: 客单价
metrics.description: GMV ÷ 下单用户数（按人计算）。按订单计算的是“笔单价”。

notes: 数据范围：华东（行级权限由系统强制执行，结果只包含你有权限的数据）。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），客单价为 379.61 元（GMV 13.36 万元，下单用户数 352 人）。

queries.title: 客单价
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    region_id IN ('east')
) AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000
